Privacy,
plainly.

next roll is a local film notebook. The app does not collect your camera, roll or film-fridge data.

Your data stays on your phone

Camera names, film rolls, notes, dates and fridge inventory are stored locally on your device. They are not uploaded to our servers or shared with us.

No account or advertising trackers

next roll does not require an account and does not use advertising trackers or data brokerage. We collect a small amount of anonymous usage data, such as app opens, feature use and website page views, to understand what is useful.

If you contact support

If you email us, we receive the information you choose to include in that message, such as your email address and support question. We use it only to reply.

Questions

For privacy questions, write to privacy@nextroll.app.
